prose: DeepSeek has agreed to lead a seed round of tens of millions of dollars in Winverse AI, a months-old robotic AI startup, valuing it at roughly $400 million post-money, per Bloomberg sources. Basis: the article is paywalled and only the headline detail was retrievable.
highlights: DeepSeek to lead Winverse AI's seed round of tens of millions of dollars.
Winverse, a months-old robotics AI startup, valued at ~$400M post-money.
